spanish: Y en muchedumbre de tu exaltación derribas a tus levantados; envías tu ardor, los come como rastrojo.

findings.issue: Qal active participle (those who rise) plus 2ms suffix is rendered as passive/resultative 'levantados' (those raised), shifting voice and who acts.

notes: The other tokens match person, number, and stem, including 3ms 'come' with 3mp 'los'.
